title: Java Programming
shortDescription: Learn Java from syntax and OOP through collections, JDBC, Spring foundations and practical projects.
detailedDescription: Learn Java from syntax and OOP through collections, JDBC, Spring foundations and practical projects. The curriculum moves from fundamentals to guided practice, projects and interview preparation.
learningObjectives: Understand Java syntax and program structure
Use OOP principles to model applications
Work confidently with collections and exceptions
Connect Java applications to MySQL with JDBC
prerequisites: Basic computer usage and logical reasoning
